notes.title: PvP gameplay mode: the Chaos Arena
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35022669/1dc5de5bdf39594c38dd956f2baee28351b1eafc.jpg

The highly-anticipated PvP gameplay mode: the Chaos Arena, will debut soon! Our royal scouts have compiled a detailed report about the Chaos Arena below. Don't forget to share this with your allies and prepare yourselves for what lies ahead!

A) Gameplay
The Chaos Arena is an intense battleground event where players from different Kingdoms can compete against each other, and complete Arena Quests to earn generous rewards. You will not lose troops in battles or resources in raids in this Arena. There is no Infirmary capacity limit, and both Infirmary Healing Cost and Healing Duration will be reduced by 90%.
Each event will last for 1 week, divided into a preparation phase (1 day), a battle phase (5 days), and an ending phase (1 day).

B) Entry Requirements
- Must be at Castle Lv 5 and above
- No Wounded Troops in the Infirmary
- Battle Fury must be inactive
- No Troops outside Turf
- Each Arena has a capacity limit. If an Arena you want to enter is full, please try again later.
*Note: You can only represent the Home Dominion you were in when the preparation phase starts. You will not be able to participate if you switch Dominions.

C) Arena Quests
Arena Quests include occupying Wonders, defeating Enemy Troops, healing Wounded Troops, hunting Monsters, gathering resources, and more. Complete quest phases to earn Chaos Stones, which can be exchanged in the Chaos Shop for Records, Champion Chests, Steampath Chests, Archaic Tomes, and more.

D) Battles
Upon entering the Chaos Arena, you can choose to complete quests, observe, or occupy various Wonders. Wonders in the Arena will gradually unlock as time progresses. After the Arena opens, Border Stations will be unlocked after 1 hour, Relay Bunkers after 2 hours, and the Chaos Citadel after 4 hours. Each Arena has multiple Border Stations and Relay Bunkers, but only one Chaos Citadel.

E) Notes
1. Certain Familiar skills cannot be used in the Chaos Arena.
2. You will not lose resources or trigger Extra Supplies if your Turf is attacked in the Chaos Arena
3. You can re-enter the Chaos Arena during the event, but there will be a 10m cooldown after entering. You cannot re-enter during this cooldown.
4. Leaders can only be imprisoned for 5 minutes in the Chaos Arena. Items cannot be used to execute prisoners or escape from Prison. Bounty or ransom can't be set for these prisoners. 
5. Actions in the Chaos Arena will be included in event statistics

Please refer to the in-game event page for the final event rules and more details!

notes.title: Guild Fest: Trio Power!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35022669/5d0cd55b8c6675a96109df80da5b54ed604a1dbe.png

Join us for a special Guild Fest as we get into the spirit of the World Championship! From now until 19:59, 05/20/2024 (GMT-5), assemble a team consisting of three players on the event page during the registration phase to receive a Team Reward. Reach the designated number of Solo Points during the Guild Fest to receive bonus rewards like Crimson Chests and more! 

These teams of three will compete in the rankings, and the top teams with the most points will receive Ranking Rewards. Prizes include a Lords Mobile x Logitech Keyboard and Mouse Set, [Uncommon] Records x 5000, Artifact Coin x6000, Mystic Carpet II x20, and more! 

[Event Duration]

Registration Period: 00:00, 05/17/2024 - 19:59, 05/20/2024 (GMT-5)
Earn points from: 00:00, 05/20/2024 - 23:59, 05/26/2024 (GMT-5)
Claim rewards from: 00:00, 05/20/2024 - 23:59, 05/27/2024 (GMT-5)

[How to Play]

1. All players can form/join teams during the Registration Phase. Players may apply to teams or leave teams during this period, but must have a complete team before the Registration Phase ends to compete in this event. 
2. All team members will get to claim a Team Reward once their team is full. This reward can only be claimed once. 
3. The Scoring Phase will start after registration ends, and all complete teams (teams with 3 members) will be able to participate in the rankings. 
4. Reach the designated number of Guild Fest Points to claim a free bonus item on the event page. 
5. Rankings will be based on the sum of Solo Guild Fest points from all 3 team members. If two or more teams have the same number of Guild Fest points, the one who obtained the points first will be ranked ahead. 

[Event Rewards]

1. Team Reward: 3,000 Linked Gems
2. Solo Phase Rewards: Please refer to the event page for details. 
3. Ranking Rewards (per team member)
1st Place: Lords Mobile x Logitech Keyboard and Mouse Set, [Uncommon] Records x 5000, Artifact Coins x 6000, Mystic Carpet II x 20
2nd-3rd place: Lords Mobile x Logitech Keyboard and Mouse Set, [Uncommon] Records x 3000, Artifact Coins x 4000, Mystic Carpet II x 8
4th-10th place: Lords Mobile x Logitech Keyboard and Mouse Set, [Uncommon] Records x 2000, Artifact Coins x 3000, Mystic Carpet II x 5
11th-25th place: [Uncommon] Records x800, Artifact Coins x1000, Mystic Carpet I x5
26th-50th place: [Uncommon] Records x600, Artifact Coin x600, Mystic Carpet I x4
51st-100th place: [Uncommon] Records x500, Artifact Coin x500, Mystic Carpet I x3

[Event Rules]

1. Each IGGID can only claim 1 Team Reward. 
2. It will take about 2-10 minutes for Guild Fest points to be updated on the event page. Please be patient and wait for the points to be updated. 
3. Please collect the items you have won during the designated reward collection period. If your team wins a ranking reward, we will contact you and your teammates via in-game mail to collect your shipping information for the physical prizes within 3 working days. 
4. All in-game items won during the event will be sent directly to the player’s account. Physical prizes will be sent out within 60 working days after the event ends. We reserve the right to substitute prizes of equal value if prizes are out of stock, out of production, not available for sale, etc. 
5. This event is hosted by IGG SINGAPORE PTE. LTD. and is subject to Singapore's tax laws. Prizes (or prize money) may be subject to tax, which will be paid by IGG SINGAPORE PTE. LTD. 
This event is covered by the [Terms of Service] (Gear button - Help - Terms of Service).

Lords Mischief is coming soon, and we've got many tricks up our sleeve!

# New [Artifact] system (reach Castle Lv 6 and clear Skirmish 2 to unlock):

notes.title: Dragon Arena FAQs
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35022669/3ba624e585972f63facd86b1298625eb42c44285.png

How to play:

1. In the Dragon Arena, guilds are paired for a guild versus guild battle. To win, guilds must earn points by occupying Strongholds.
2. The Wonders in the Dragon Arena are named Strongholds. Strongholds include Outposts, Transporters, Hot Springs, Ancient Remains, Citadels, etc. Each Stronghold grants a different amount of points when occupied, and some even grant special boosts. 
The Dragon Altar lies in the center of the Dragon Arena, and serves as the starting point for Caravans. The Dragon Altar cannot be occupied.
3. You must defend a Stronghold for 3 minutes before it is considered occupied. Once occupied, your guild will earn Guild Points and Solo Points.        
4. When a Caravan reaches a Stronghold, the side that has occupied the Stronghold will earn a ton of points. 
5. You will not lose troops in this event. Wounded troops will be healed, damaged traps will be repaired, and your Wall will be restored once you leave the arena.
6. After the round ends, the guild that has earned more points will emerge victorious. Both guilds will win prizes based on the outcome.        
7. Dragite awarded in the event can be exchanged for hero in the Dragite Shop.

Q: What are the requirements to participate in the Dragon Arena?
A: Guilds must register to participate in this event. Only guilds with at least 30 members with Castle Lv 17 and above before the event starts are eligible; rank 4 and above members can register and choose from 8 time slots for the event. The time slot can be changed at any time during the registration phase.

Q: Why I cannot see the event page or participate in the event?
A: Kindly update the game to the latest version to see the event page and participate in the event

Q: Why can't I enter the Dragon Arena?
A: You must meet the following requirements to enter the Dragon Arena:
- Must be in the guild you were in when the event began.
- Must be at Castle Lv 17 and above
- No wounded troops in the Infirmary
- No damaged traps 
- At full Wall HP
- Battle Fury must be inactive
- No troops outside of Turf

Additional Note: Each player can only enter the Dragon Arena once. You cannot re-enter if you leave midway through.

Q: How are guilds matched? My guild was matched with a guild with higher might!
A: During the registration period, guilds with a comparable number of Cups will be matched together. While you may be matched with a guild in a different League, it will be a fair match.

Q: If my guild doesn't register for the event, will our League and Cups be affected?
A: No. They will stay in their original League and will not lose any Cups.

Q: Why is everything in the Dragon Arena in Protection Phase?
A:  If you enter the Dragon Arena when you are without a guild or if it is currently not your guild's time slot, all Strongholds will be seen as being in Protection Phase. 

Q: Why can't I attack others/transport/attack the Citadel, Hot Springs, or Ancient Remains?
A: During the Preparation Phase (first 5 minutes before the battle), players cannot initiate attacks or transport. Outposts and Transporters will have a 5 minute Shield, while the Citadel, Hot Springs, and Ancient Remains will have a 10 minute Shield.

Q: Are transports in the Arena free?
A: Only the first transport is free and will not consume items. Subsequent transports will consume Relocators. Guilds in the Advanced League and above will have a Transport Limit. In these Leagues, the first Transport will consume a Guild Transport. 

Q: Can I return to the protected area after leaving?
A: No. You will only be placed there when you first enter the Dragon Arena. 

Note: Players in this area cannot be attacked, or initiate an attack. However, they can join a rally, and send reinforcements to Strongholds.

Q: Why can't I return to the protected area?
A: This is a special area that you will be placed in only when you first enter. You cannot use Relocators to return to this area.

Q: I occupied a Transporter, but did not earn any Transports!
A: Transports are shared between the guild. These may have been used up by your guild members during battles.

Q: Can I send resources to my guildmates in the Dragon Arena?
A: No. You cannot send or receive resources in the Dragon Arena. You will also not lose any resources if you are attacked.

Q: How do I occupy Strongholds?
A: Guilds must successfully defend the Stronghold for 3 minutes to occupy it and earn points. Guilds will receive Guild Points for the first occupation of each Stronghold. Guild members who have sent their troops to the Stronghold will also get Solo Points. After occupying a Stronghold, the guild will earn a number of Guild and Solo Points every second.

Q: Why can't I use some Familiar skills in the Dragon Arena?
A: Blazing Trail (Pyris), Kiss of Death (Grim Reaper), Divine Retribution (Bon Appeti), and Hellfire (Blackwing) cannot be used in the Dragon Arena. If Hellfire is activated before entering the Dragon Arena, its effects will be dispelled upon entry.

Q: I attacked a player, but their troops didn't die!
A: Troops in the Dragon Arena will not die; they will only be wounded.

Q: Will my kills in the Dragon Arena be counted in my profile statistics?
A: No.

Note: Actions in the Dragon Arena will not grant Player EXP or Hero EXP.

Q: The leader I captured fled!
A: Leaders captured in the Dragon Arena will only be imprisoned for 5 minutes. You cannot use items to execute them. All prisoners captured in the Dragon Arena will also be released once the captor leaves the arena.

Q: Why do my actions in the Dragon Arena not count towards my Guild Fest/Guild Bash tasks?
A: As per the event rules, you will not be able to earn KVK, Guild Fest, or Guild Bash points in the Dragon Arena.

Q: Can I leave the guild while in the arena?
A: No. You cannot leave or be kicked out of the guild during the event. The guild leader also cannot disband the guild, or change the guild's kingdom to K70.

Q: I participated in the Dragon Arena but didn't get any rewards!
A: Please ensure that you are still in the guild that you represented. You must stay in that guild to get your rewards.

Q: It was a tie, but we only got consolation rewards!
A: According to event rules, in the case of a tie, both guilds will get the Consolation Rewards. Cups can still be won or lost, and will be calculated the same way.

Q: Why can't I relocate back after the battle ended?
A: You can only leave the Dragon Arena by tapping on the [Leave] button.
